Print help on specific command.

## Synopsis

```text
help [<command>]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Without argument a table of all commands the console may run; with a command its usage.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<command>` | resource | command names |  | positional | Command to describe. |

## Examples

Usage of purge:

```text
help purge
```

Table of every command this console may run:

```text
help
```

All arguments of run:

```text
help run
```
